nyheter.title: Virtual Counseling Gives Sailors More Mental Health Options
nyheter.summary: ARLINGTON, Va. — The Navy is using virtual counseling to help meet the mental health needs of its sailors, a panel of suicide prevention experts told reporters Thursday. There are currently 54 virtual counselors available, hired by Commander, Navy Installations Command, to help with the mental health needs of the fleet, Shauna Turner, CNIC Navy family readiness program director, told reporters. nyheter.title: Navy Wants Containerized, Low-cost Interceptors to Defeat Cruise Missiles, Drones
nyheter.summary: The U.S. Navy wants to deploy containerized low-cost interceptors to defeat cruise missiles and attack drones, according to a request for white papers released Wednesday. Dubbed the Naval Affordable Interceptor, the concept seeks to field a container launcher that can carry at least 60 missiles. The system’s installation should not require permanent modification aboard its host warship.
